build_maxcut_weighted: build a MaxCut instance with weighted edges to estimate peak memory usage of a graph
build_maxcut_unweighted: build a MaxCut instance with unweighted edges to find the maximum number of live tensors
run_locatecut: run LocateCut on a MaxCut object to partition the graph and find the maximum cut
run_locatecut_with_schedule: run LocateCut with a user_schedule dict to add ordering constraints on nodes
review_maxcut_debug: review the MaxCut LocateCut method with debug mode enabled to print solver results and edge details
